entities.label: Person
entities.summary: James Baillie Fraser was a Scottish travel writer, and artist who illustrated and wrote about Asia Minor, Iran, India and Kurdistan. Some of his watercolours made in the picturesque style represent early views of India and Iran. He was a brother of William Fraser.
